newsitem.title: INDIA: American Express Bank cuts Indian prime rate.
newsitem.headline: American Express Bank cuts Indian prime rate.

text.p: American Express Bank said on Thursday it reduced its Indian prime lending rate to 16.0 percent per annum from 17.25 percent effective May 1.
The rate is exclusive of interest tax, a bank official said.
The reduction in lending rate follows Reserve Bank of India's monetary and credit policy for the first half of 1997/98 (April-March) announced on Tuesday.
The credit policy cut deposit rate in a bid to induce banks to reduce lending rates. Some banks have already lowered their prime lending rates.
